answer: Each agent must post a bond that is slashed when a challenge reveals fabricated or colluding identities; rewards accrue only after the bonded agent completes independently verifiable work over time. A jade ledger records bonds and penalties, while violet marks identify agents whose claims are under review before they can count toward a summit vote. A Sybil attacker can still create many accounts, but must lock real capital in each one and risks losing it, making fake identities expensive rather than merely numerous.
